name: Juridische Adviseur: fase A checks
description: Check a dossier analysis (fase A) against the fixed rules and summarise a run.

item.label: Dataset item
item.description: The dossier from the dataset with input, expected_output and metadata, for example {{ dataset_item_ophalen }}.

analysis.label: Dossier analysis
analysis.description: The output of the agent call, for example {{ dossieranalyse_uitvoeren }}. The node looks up the result of 'Analyse afronden eval' in it. When the call failed, the output has a task_error and no scores.

analysis_format.label: Format of the analysis
analysis_format.description: Output of the Limescape agent is first converted to the output contract. Choose 'already in the output contract' for another solution that returns the contract itself.

results.label: Results per dossier
results.description: The output of 'Check one dossier' for all dossiers of the run, for example the output of the agent call in the loop.

expected_items.label: Dataset items of the run
expected_items.description: The items the run had to cover, for example {{ dataset_ophalen.items }}. The summary uses it to report dossiers that did not run.

baseline.label: Approved baseline
baseline.description: The content of fase-a/approved-baseline.json. A dossier that met all hard requirements there and does not now is a regression. Empty = no comparison.

fail_on_regression.label: Fail on regression
fail_on_regression.description: On = the node fails on a regression, a dossier that did not run or a failed analysis, and the flow stops. Off = the outcome is in gate_passed.
